name: radarr-2160p-database
description: Two Radarr profiles. Movies 2160p is Dumpstarr's profile under that name: DTS-HD MA, DTS-HD HRA, DTS-X, and plain DTS score the same as Dolby Digital +, TrueHD including TrueHD Atmos scores -10000 for every release group, and a 20-60 GB Blu-ray encode from the preferred disc groups scores 4200. Minimum score 1000, upgrade until 10000. TRaSH Remux + WEB 2160p is a separate profile taken from TRaSH Guides Remux + WEB 2160p, with TRaSH qualities and TRaSH custom format scores. It does not use the Movies 2160p audio layer.
